# odinex_location (Data Source)

Looks up a location (region) by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "odinex_location" "fra1" {
  name = "fra1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) ID of the location.
- `name` (String) Name of the location.

### Read-Only

- `city` (String) City.
- `country` (String) ISO country code.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `network_zone` (String) Network zone.
- `status` (String) `active`, `maintenance` or `soldout`.
